category_edits.rationale: Average the existing pairwise-plus-0.2-pointwise loss within each sequence, then equally across nonempty sequences. This may better align training with user-averaged HR@10 by removing longer histories' greater aggregate weight. Apply the shared loss change to all four datasets while preserving architecture, inference, sampling and training settings.

edits.replace:
valid_counts = mask.sum(dim=1)
    sequence_losses = (loss * mask).sum(dim=1) / valid_counts.clamp(min=1.0)
    valid_sequences = valid_counts.gt(0).to(loss.dtype)
    return (sequence_losses * valid_sequences).sum() / valid_sequences.sum().clamp(min=1.0)

change_summary: Change only loss aggregation to equal sequence weighting across all four datasets. Individual loss terms and the single GRU4Rec model per category remain unchanged; predictor updates are unnecessary.
